story.text: Portugal beat Switzerland 6-1 in the Round of 16 of the FIFA World Cup 2022. Switzerland had more of the ball (53 percent to 47 percent), and Portugal created the better chances by expected goals, or xG, a measure of chance quality (2.40 to 0.96). The goals came from Gonçalo Ramos at 16:43, Pepe at 32:35, Gonçalo Ramos at 50:05, Raphaël Guerreiro at 54:55, Manuel Akanji at 57:05, Gonçalo Ramos at 66:12 and Rafael Leão at 91:12.
